summary: A modal synth for mallets, bars, bells and plucks, with a resonator mode: each note rings a bank of up to 32 decaying modes (soft, hard, metal and bright bars, a tube, a bell, a tine, a stiff string, glass, a plate, or a custom stretched series), struck by a mallet whose contact time sets how much of the highs it excites, at a position along the body that weighs each mode, or plucked. Decay, a damping tilt that kills the highs sooner, brightness, a tremolo, release damping and velocity to hardness shape it. In Resonator mode any audio into the machine rings the same mode bank, tuned to the notes you hold, with Mix and Amount. 16 voices. Use it for marimba, vibraphone and glockenspiel, chimes, bells, music-box tines, harp-like plucks, glass pads, and for turning drum loops and noise into pitched resonances.
use_for: Modal synth for marimba, vibraphone and glockenspiel bars, tubular chimes, bells, tines, plucks and glass, and a resonator that tunes any audio input to the notes held: tuned percussion, bell pads, drum loops turned into pitched resonances.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The body: which modes the note rings (their frequency ratios and weights)
parameters.how: Chooses the body that rings: a soft (marimba-like) bar, a hard (xylophone-like) bar, a metal (vibraphone-like) bar, a bright (glockenspiel-like) bar, a tube, a bell, a tine, a stiff string, glass, a plate, or a custom stretched series.
parameters.sound: Bars are woody or metallic and pitched, the tube is hollow, the bell is deep with a minor-third shimmer, the tine is thin and sweet, the string is plucked, glass has a slow beating, the plate is clangorous and the custom series bends from harmonic to bell-like.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Where the energy comes from: a note strikes (or plucks) the bodies, or the audio input rings the bodies tuned to the held notes
parameters.how: Mallet: every note strikes a body of its own. Resonator: nothing is struck, the audio coming into the machine drives one body for each held note.
parameters.sound: Mallet plays tuned percussion; Resonator turns drums, noise or any sound into pitched ringing that follows your keys.

parameters.name: Hardness
parameters.description: The mallet's contact time with the body, 12 ms (a soft felt head) down to 0.3 ms (a hard stick): a short contact excites the high modes, a long one only the low
parameters.how: Sets how hard the mallet is, from a soft head that touches the bar for 12 ms to a hard stick that touches it for 0.3 ms. The knob reads the contact time.
parameters.sound: Soft heads give a round, dull thud with few overtones; hard sticks give a bright, clicking, ringing attack.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Where along the body the mallet strikes: each mode n is weighed by the sine of n times pi times the position (bells, glass and plates by their own shape), so a mode at a node is nearly silent
parameters.how: Moves the strike across the body from one end (0 %) to the other (100 %); in Resonator mode it moves the point where the modes are heard.
parameters.sound: The centre brings out the fundamental and hides the second mode; towards the ends the overtones take over and the tone turns thin and nasal.

parameters.name: Velocity to hardness
parameters.description: How much the note's velocity changes the contact time: at 100 % a hard hit (velocity 127) is about 8 times shorter, and a soft hit 8 times longer, than the Hardness setting
parameters.how: Sets how much a hard hit also makes the mallet harder, from 0 % (velocity only changes the level) to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Soft hits are dull and quiet, hard hits bright and loud, as with a real mallet.

parameters.name: Mallet noise
parameters.description: The share of noise in the strike, a short burst shaped by the contact: the sound of the mallet's own impact
parameters.how: Sets how much noise the strike adds, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A little adds the knock of the mallet on the wood; a lot makes a breathy, clacking attack.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the fundamental, the time it takes to fall by 60 dB (T60)
parameters.how: Sets how long the fundamental rings, as the time to fall by 60 dB, from 0.05 to 20 s.
parameters.sound: Short times are dry wooden knocks; long times ring like metal bars, bells and chimes.

parameters.name: Damping tilt
parameters.description: How much sooner the high modes die than the fundamental: at 100 % a mode twice as high decays in a quarter of the time (a model that rings on in the highs, such as the metal bar, uses less)
parameters.how: Sets how much faster the high modes fade than the fundamental, from 0 % (all modes ring as long as the fundamental) to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More tilt gives a warm, quick-darkening note; less keeps the sparkle ringing.

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Tilts the level of the modes with frequency: +100 % raises each octave up by 6 dB, -100 % lowers it by 6 dB
parameters.how: Sets the balance between low and high modes, from -100 % (dark) to +100 % (bright).
parameters.sound: Down it is round and dull; up it is glassy and edgy.

parameters.name: Release damping
parameters.description: How fast a released note is damped: the time for it to fall by 60 dB after the key goes up (a stopped note is faded in at least 3 ms)
parameters.how: Sets how quickly letting go of a key stops the sound, from 5 ms (a hand on the bar) to 2 s.
parameters.sound: Short times stop the note at once like a damper; long times let notes ring out as on an open instrument.

parameters.name: Modes
parameters.description: How many modes each note rings, 4 to 32 (modes above 0.45 of the sample rate are dropped)
parameters.how: Sets the number of modes in each note's body, from 4 to 32.
parameters.sound: Few modes sound plain and cheap to play; many modes sound rich and complex.

parameters.name: Stretch
parameters.description: Custom model: each mode is this many cents higher than a harmonic series would put it, per mode number step (0 is a harmonic series, positive bends it bell-like)
parameters.how: Bends the Custom series: how many cents each mode is pushed per step of its number.
parameters.sound: Zero sounds like an organ pipe or a plucked string; more turns it into a bell, less into something hollow.

parameters.name: Inharmonicity
parameters.description: Stiff-string and Custom models: the inharmonicity B of a stiff string, mode n sits at n times the fundamental times the square root of one plus B times n squared, with B = 0.02 times the setting squared, so B = 0.02 at 100 %
parameters.how: Sets the stiffness of the string, from 0 (a perfect harmonic series) to 100 % (B = 0.02, a stiff piano bass string and beyond).
parameters.sound: A little makes the string sound real and slightly bright; a lot makes it clang.

parameters.name: Tremolo rate
parameters.description: Rate of the tremolo, the level swing of a vibraphone's rotating fans
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the tremolo from 0.5 to 12 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow is a gentle swell; fast is a flutter.

parameters.name: Tremolo depth
parameters.description: Depth of the tremolo: at 100 % the level swings between full and silent
parameters.how: Sets how deeply the level swings, from 0 % (off) to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Turn it up for the pulsing of a vibraphone with its motor on.

parameters.name: Input drive
parameters.description: Resonator mode: the level of the audio driving the modes
parameters.how: Sets how loud the audio is when it enters the modes, from -24 to +12 dB.
parameters.sound: More drive makes the pitched ringing louder against the dry sound.

parameters.name: Stereo spread
parameters.description: How far the notes are placed left and right by their pitch (0 % is all centre)
parameters.how: Sets how widely low and high notes are spread across the stereo field, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Like a real instrument seen from the front, low bars sit left and high bars right.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from off to +12.
parameters.sound: It makes the instrument louder or quieter without changing its character.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet: the audio coming in against the sound of the modes (the dry signal is not delayed: there is no latency)
parameters.how: Blends the audio coming into the machine with the sound of the modes.
parameters.sound: At 100 % you hear only the modes; lower values keep the input, so a drum loop stays and gains a pitched ring.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: how strongly the modes act, 100 % = the settings as they stand, 0 = the input unchanged (bit for bit), 200 % = exaggerated (a longer decay and a harder drive)
parameters.how: Scales the decay time of the modes and the drive of the input at once, so the ringing grows or fades without changing its tuning; at 0 % the machine is out of the signal path and the input passes bit for bit.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to hear the ringing fade out of the sound, and up to make the resonances longer and louder.
